verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents several headless entry points: a terminal launch (`uvx arize-phoenix serve`), Docker/Kubernetes/Helm deployments, and a phoenix-cli. Its Python and TypeScript SDKs run evaluations against traces or datasets with full control over pipelines, and dataset evaluators act as a unit-test-style harness for spotting regressions. Together these cover programmatic, UI-free automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration docs or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions, exit-code gating on eval results), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use.
